| **Channel operator** (`operator_partner_id`) | many2one → `res.partner` |  | Who runs this channel and bills its commission. Naming it is what makes the reverse charge on its services apply. |

| **Processing product** (`processor_fee_product_id`) | many2one → `product.product` |  | What the processor's charge is bought as. It is a banking cost rather than a selling commission, and rarely the same account. |

| **Payment processor** (`processor_provider`) | selection |  | Whose statement says what this channel's payments cost, when that is not the channel itself. A shop of one's own keeps nothing: it is the processor that does. |
| **Settles in** (`settlement_currency_id`) | many2one → `res.currency` |  | The currency whoever collects for this channel pays out in, when it converts every sale into it.
